major_work.name: Evidence-Gated Model Router and Abstention Layer
major_work.problem: KMB can accumulate many challengers whose outputs are incomparable, sparsely validated, or valid only in specific data/regime conditions. A naive ensemble risks model proliferation, double-counting correlated evidence, and false confidence.
major_work.hypothesis: A predeclared evidence-gated router that selects, combines, or abstains based on data availability, validation status, regime support and feature overlap can improve reliability and maintenance cost versus exposing every model output equally.

hard_gates: production_eligible must be true before production routing
sample/regime gate failure => SHADOW_ONLY or ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN
stale input beyond model contract => ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN
anti_double_counting: compute feature/evidence fingerprint overlap before ensemble
high-overlap challengers are compared, not blindly averaged
shared upstream evidence is represented once in confidence accounting
design.current_expected_output: ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN because current canonical validated sample counts are insufficient for production routing

AI-C: define frozen router score/gates before outcome labels
nested walk-forward so model selection does not leak validation results
compare router against single-model and naive ensemble baselines
AI-B: audit provenance and as-of chronology of every routed model input
falsify confidence wording and causal overclaim
verify shared evidence is not counted as independent confirmation
AI-D: only when implementation begins: expose registry/freshness/provenance status as machine-readable router inputs
keep router failure fail-closed to ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN rather than stopping unrelated services

kill_criteria: router does not beat simple single-model selection on out-of-sample calibration or false-confidence rate
abstention removes so much coverage that practical utility collapses without reliability gain
feature-overlap control cannot prevent correlated evidence double counting
maintenance complexity exceeds measurable reliability benefit
major_work.next_stage_gate: Remain architecture hypothesis until at least two challengers have point-in-time validated samples; freeze routing rules before comparative labels and keep UNKNOWN as the default.
